timing: Created after the full-object download request began but before any X-derived extraction or cell-context outcome was read. It corrects interpretation, not samples, states, thresholds, outcomes or models.

corrections.old: Composition positive and CT-state change unstable supports composition-dominant.
corrections.new: Do not infer dominance from significant-versus-nonsignificant. A composition-dominant description requires jointly evaluable patient/site data, the two-group algebraic decomposition, effect estimates and uncertainty to support a materially larger composition contribution.

corrections.old: If both axes are null, the bulk association does not transfer.
corrections.new: If neither axis receives support, state only that this cohort provides no support or is inconclusive; do not equate nonsignificance with non-transfer.

corrections.old: Kitagawa within-state contribution may be read as purely intracellular.
corrections.new: The CT term is within the fixed CT state. The other-epithelium term also contains shifts among the heterogeneous non-CT epithelial substates, so the combined within-group term is not a pure intracellular regulatory effect.

corrections.old: Exact label permutation may appear to remove design confounding.
corrections.new: Permutation is exact only under label exchangeability. All remitters are v3.1, so it cannot remove chemistry/outcome confounding; show the v3.1-only sensitivity alongside it.

unchanged: fixed CT state and epithelial denominator
